user.title: eduVULCAN registration
user.description: Log in at https://eduvulcan.pl/api/ap in your browser, open the page source and copy the value of the hidden <input> element (a JSON with a "Tokens" list) — or just the JWT token(s). Paste it below. Tokens are one-time use and are not stored.

data.tokens: JWT token(s) or the JSON from /api/ap

error.no_tokens: No JWT token found in the pasted text.
error.invalid_jwt: The JWT could not be decoded (no tenant in payload).
error.invalid_token: Vulcan rejected the token (wrong, expired or already used). Log in again and copy a fresh one.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Vulcan API.
error.no_pupils: Registration succeeded but no pupils were returned.

abort.already_configured: This eduVULCAN account is already configured.

send_latest.name: Send latest messages
send_latest.description: Fires eduvulcan_message and eduvulcan_announcement events for the newest message and announcement, with test set to true.

init.title: eduVULCAN messages (web)
init.description: Since November 2026 the mobile API serves messages only with eduVULCAN Premium. With your eduVULCAN e-mail and password the integration reads messages from the web module (wiadomosci.eduvulcan.pl) instead. The password is stored in plain text in Home Assistant, and opening a new message may mark it as read in eduVULCAN. One entry is enough for all pupils of the account. Leave both fields empty to turn it off.

web_auth.title: eduVULCAN: web login rejected
web_auth.description: eduVULCAN rejected the e-mail or password set in the integration options, so messages are not being read. Correct them in Settings → Devices & services → eduVULCAN → Configure. No further attempts are made until they change.

web_captcha.title: eduVULCAN: captcha required
web_captcha.description: eduVULCAN asks for a captcha at login, so messages are not being read. Log in once at https://eduvulcan.pl in a browser; the integration retries in a few hours. It never solves captchas itself.
